thesis: AMPH is a profitable, accelerating healthcare name after a Q3 beat, and healthcare is the leading sector in a neutral, defensive-tilted regime. The trend is up above SMA20/50/200 and price is consolidating on declining volume after the earnings gap, so the entry zone does not chase. Valuation looks undemanding on earnings and the expanded buyback gives support. This is a modest setup, not a high-conviction one: reward/risk is only 1.41 and the 31.00 rejection candle caps the score.
